# Robot Catalog

> Open catalog of 1004 mobile robots in 9 categories — humanoids, quadrupeds, AMRs, AGVs, wheel-legged robots, delivery robots and development platforms — each with its published specs and the maker source behind every value.

Robot Catalog is a static, bilingual (English/Korean) catalog of mobile robots by 453 makers. Every value comes from the maker's own page, datasheet, manual, press release or lab paper and is linked on the robot's page; where the maker states nothing the field stays empty rather than being estimated. The catalog records published specs only — there is no scoring, no rating and no ranking.

- Robots: 1004. 869 records are verified against a maker source, 208 carry a full spec sheet.
- One page per robot: https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/robot.html?id=<id>
- One Markdown file per robot, with the full spec sheet and a source on every value: https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/md/<id>.md
- Data last merged: 2026-11-26.
- To cite a spec, link the robot's page and the maker document printed next to the value in its Markdown file.
- Attribution: some humanoid prices and sales status come from HumanoidStore open data (CC BY 4.0, humanoidstore.co); the records that use it say so in their Markdown file.

## Pages

- [All robots](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/index.html): every robot as a card, filterable by category and searchable by name or maker.
- [Mega table](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/table.html): every robot and every field in one sortable table, with CSV download.
- [Dashboard](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/dashboard.html): speed, payload, wheel diameter, IP rating and feature coverage across the catalog.
- [All specs](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/specs.html): every spec field in the catalog, with the robots that publish it.
- [Full catalog in one file](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/llms-full.txt): every robot's core specs and sources in a single text file.
- [Full spec sheets as JSON](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/data/specs/): one file per robot, keyed by the same id.

- [Data schema](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/data/SCHEMA.md): what each record field means, and how unknown values are recorded.
- [Raw records](https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/data/robots.json): every robot as JSON — the file the site reads.
